thinkingSteps.title: Why it is slow
thinkingSteps.body: Count the nested work. If each choice restarts a full scan, time blows up. Name the cost before optimizing — interviewers want that honesty. Target after the insight: O(m * n).

thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: To check if one binary tree is a subtree of another, we can use a recursive approach. For each node in the main tree, we check if the current subtree rooted at that node is equal to the given subtree. If not, we recursively check the left and right subtrees.
